limitations_and_boundaries: The study is limited to the 5xFAD mouse model of Alzheimer's disease; findings may not fully translate to human AD.
The microglial surface receptor(s) for sTREM2 remain unknown.
sTREM2 does not significantly impact the amount of dystrophic neurites per plaque, suggesting it does not contribute to compacting amyloid fibrils.
The study does not include single-cell transcriptomics to examine how sTREM2 modulates microglial gene expression.
